setup_unpaired_audio_text_task: setup the UnpairedAudioText task by loading dictionaries from the text data directory
load_dataset_for_split: load an unpaired audio text dataset for a given split with optional random text pairing
compute_valid_step_metrics: run a validation step that computes unit error rate and language model perplexity metrics
reduce_metrics_for_uer: reduce logging outputs to derive unit error rate, LM perplexity, and weighted LM perplexity metrics
configure_decoding_with_kenlm: configure decoding with KenLM language model paths and Kaldi decoder settings for word-level scoring
